About me

I'm a graphic designer based in the Philippines. I create visual content that communicates ideas, brands, and emotions.

Every project starts with a question: what should people feel and understand in the first few seconds? I work across posters, logos, social media, and animation, and I enjoy the process as much as the result.

Pumpkin Spice Latte

A poster promoting the Pumpkin Spice Latte for Brew Haven.

The layout highlights the drink as the focal point, with the key selling points of real pumpkin, warm spices, and rich espresso shown as icons along the side.

Details

  • Client: Brew Haven
  • Category: Poster

Brew Haven Landing Page

A landing page for Brew Haven, a coffee shop that invites visitors to slow down.

The hero pairs a warm, dark photo with a serif headline and an accent word in italics, followed by two clear calls to action: see the menu and visit the shop.

Details

  • Client: Brew Haven
  • Category: Web design

The Walking Dead Typography Poster

A typography-led poster study for the film The Walking Dead: The Movie.

Oversized condensed headline type with a distressed texture carries the poster, supported by a centered layout, thin ornamental dividers, and a restrained orange-on-navy palette.

Details

  • Category: Poster
  • Type: Concept / practice piece

Graphic Designer King Badge

A circular badge mark for Graphic Designer King, built around the gradient dot palette.

The name wraps around the outer ring in bold type, with eight gray dots inside the circle and KING set at the base. It's designed to work as a stamp, sticker, or social profile mark.

Details

  • Client: Personal brand
  • Category: Logo
Back to projects

Horizontal Logo Lockup

A horizontal logo lockup pairing the dot mark with the KING wordmark.

A thin vertical divider separates the gradient dot mark from the wordmark, with GRAPHIC DESIGNER set beneath KING. This version suits website headers and document letterheads.

Details

  • Client: Personal brand
  • Category: Logo

Vertical Logo Lockup

A stacked logo lockup with the name above the dot mark.

KING and GRAPHIC DESIGNER sit at the top with the gradient dots centered beneath them. It's a compact version for square spaces such as profile pictures and event posters.

Details

  • Client: Personal brand
  • Category: Logo

Brand Moodboard

A moodboard that defines the color, type, and mark system for the personal brand.

The board sets out a six-tone gray palette, the Horizon display typeface, and the circular mark. Every other piece in this portfolio draws from these choices.

Print Media Service Proposal

A proposal offering a print media design service to a local laundry shop.

The proposal introduces the service and explains why flyers and posters work for a neighborhood business. It outlines the package: one A4 flyer and one 8.5 × 11 poster as print-ready PDFs, with a consistent visual identity across both.

Details

  • Category: Print
  • Deliverables: A4 flyer, 8.5 × 11 poster
